nodes.label: Data Model
nodes.rationale: Parent-child relationships are modeled as unidirectional import references in the child to make columnar/relational (e.g. CSV) imports easier; the design choice is flagged for later re-evaluation.

nodes.label: commercetools RMF-Codegen Provider Package
nodes.rationale: rmf-codegen was chosen over other (native JS and/or official) RAML parsers because it is the only implementation found to reliably load extremely large API definitions in short time.

nodes.label: RMF-Codegen
nodes.rationale: Kotlin chosen for extension methods on RMF model types, multi-line template strings with embedded expressions, good integration with RMF Java types, and strong IDE support.

nodes.label: CsharpStringTypeRenderer
nodes.rationale: Enums are implemented forward-compatibly: unknown enum values are held by an anonymous instance carrying the JSON value so they remain usable before the SDK supports them as enum members.
